cautions: No DSM-5 diagnostic criteria depth; no treatment recommendations; no medication advice.
Ethics topics: cite APA Ethics Code + NIMH/NIH human-subjects rules; the Milgram study is fine as an attributed historical example (cite APA/OpenStax account, not raw film).

Correlation-vs-causation: the classic ice-cream/drowning example is widely attributed — use an ORIGINAL example instead (e.g., a fictional shoe-sales/beach-injuries dataset) and note correlation does not imply causation.
Sleep: no medical advice; cite NIMH/NIH sleep basics; avoid invented statistics — attribute any figures.
Memory/forgetting: Ebbinghaus forgetting-curve is standard (cite OpenStax/Noba); no invented percentages.
Development: Piaget/Erikson/Kohlberg stage names attributed to their originators (cite OpenStax/Noba).
